verdict.summary: The decision-ledger correction is consistent with the current load-bearing advisory registry design and the referenced §6 rollback runbook. It accurately states that demotion requires a registry declaration plus continue-on-error, that name changes no longer control gating, and that C2 rejects advisory-named jobs lacking a registry entry. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is introduced by this documentation-only change.
